title: Codex: a failure before turn/start is written settles Ambiguous although the prompt was provably not sent
outcome: Codex: a failure before turn/start is written settles Ambiguous although the prompt was provably not sent
acceptance: A receipted Codex prompt whose turn fails before turn/start was written is settled Rejected (retry entry kept, re-queueable), never Ambiguous, at every such exit: the thread-registration persist failure after the thread exists (src/codex.rs, the Err arm near the setup waiter that calls fail_shared_codex_turn_without_runtime_exit), the Engram config/read deadline (src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs), the reviewer-MCP exits whose detail says model work was not started, and the runtime-config persist failure before turn/start.

The design is recorded first. Proposed direction: a per-turn 'turn/start written' fact for Codex, set when the turn/start request is actually on the wire, so any failure settlement before it is Rejected by construction rather than by a note at each site; after it, Ambiguous or the turn/start reply decides.
Tests cover at least two of these exits through their production failure path, asserting Rejected with a re-queueable entry.

completion.summary: Fixed by the w-9b3a30fde03e landing (master 13063e3b, pushed 23:21:09Z). The Codex runtime_write marker (Untracked, Pending, Begun) gates the single turn/start write. apply_prompt_delivery_outcome turns Ambiguous into Rejected while the write is still Pending, so every exit before turn/start is Rejected and re-queueable by construction. Covered by the receipted Codex-write and thread-setup tests (test-d430a2b4, 9 passed) and by the landing's full gate test-eb74d4f6. Evaluation 158507f3 passed all 3 criteria.
